versions.changelog:
Initial beta release of DSC Column Encryption skill for Alibaba Cloud Data Security Center.

- Enables users to query and manage encrypted database columns through Python scripts using Alibaba Cloud CLI profiles.
- Supports filtering by region, asset type, encryption state, classification template, model, and sensitivity level.
- Allows users to enable/disable encryption, manage account access and expiry, select encryption algorithms or KMS keys, synchronize assets, and upgrade database kernels.
- Covers 25 Sddp/2026-01-20 API actions and KMS key inspection.
- Provides detailed operational rules for preserving filters, verifying pagination, and handling errors and permissions.
- No SDK installation required; uses only Python standard library and shell commands for execution.
